Portfolio risk engine / v1.3 / Product overview
Know how your portfolio behaves before the market tells you.
Institutional-grade risk analysis for anyone holding a portfolio of stocks. Up to five tickers, one pass, every number.
The problem
Every tool shows you the return. Almost none show you the risk you took to get it.
01 · HIDDEN
Returns are the part you can see
A green line tells you what happened once. It says nothing about the other years that could have happened instead, including the ones that would have taken you out.
02 · CONCENTRATED
Correlation is a hidden position
Three excellent companies in one sector is one position wearing three names. Diversification you can't measure is diversification you don't have.
03 · THE TAIL
The tail is where accounts end
Average outcomes are comfortable and useless. What matters is the worst 5%: its depth, its duration, and whether you could sit through it.

05
Risk analysis
A bad day, and a worse one.
VaR at 95% and 99% marks the loss you should expect to breach one day in twenty, and one in a hundred. CVaR says how far past it you go.
Alongside: max drawdown, beta and alpha, rolling volatility, and a replay of 2008, COVID and the 2022 rate shock against today's holdings.
Varense · Product overview
06
Monte Carlo
A thousand versions of next year.
1,000 one-year paths under bear, base and bull drift, moving together the way your holdings really do.
Percentile bands give the median outcome, the chance of profit and the chance of a 10% loss.

09
Methodology
Four decisions behind the numbers.
Geometric returns
(1 + R)^(252/n) − 1
CAGR, not mean × 252. The frontier uses the same formula, so your portfolio plots consistently against its cloud.
Correlated simulation
Σ = LLᵀ, r = μ + Lz
Cholesky-factored draws per asset, because ignoring correlation understates tail risk.
Tail, not just threshold
Historical VaR + CVaR @ 95%, 99%
Expected shortfall measures the loss beyond VaR; Basel's FRTB adopted it for capital.
Diversification, measured
(1 − avg ρ) × 100
Varense's own score, from realised correlation, not holdings count. Recomputed for each analysis window.

12
Method and trust
Nothing hidden, because nothing needs to be.
User-controlled analysis
You choose the holdings, weights and analysis period. Varense analyses what you provide. It does not infer or construct a portfolio for you.
Published maths
Standard definitions, documented down to the constants on a public methodology page.
Real market data
Twelve Data and Finnhub, pulled on every run. No synthetic series.
Educational, by design
An analysis tool, not an advisor. It never tells you what to buy or sell.
Security pass: rate limits on every costly endpoint · clean secrets audit across the full git history · sanitised error responses
